blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Criss Cross locked the No.1 seed after staying unbeaten in eight games while Savouge claimed the second semifinal ticket in the 2026 Spikers’ Turf Invitational Conference on Wednesday at FilOil EcoOil Centre in San Juan City. Criss Cross made quick work of 3B, 25-13, 25-15, 25-13, to move closer to an elimination round sweep, with Jude Garcia leading the collective effort with 11 points and five digs.
